<module id="alu">
    <description>An arithmetic logic unit (ALU) for performing various operations on two 32-bit inputs (a and b).</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="a" width_description="[31:0]">First input operand.</input>
        <input id="b" width_description="[31:0]">Second input operand.</input>
        <input id="aluc" width_description="[5:0]">Control signal for selecting the operation to be performed.</input>
        <output id="r" width_description="[31:0]">Result of the operation.</output>
        <output id="zero">Indicates if the result is zero.</output>
        <output id="carry">Indicates if a carry occurred during the operation.</output>
        <output id="negative">Indicates if the result is negative.</output>
        <output id="overflow">Indicates if an overflow occurred during the operation.</output>
        <output id="flag">General flag, set based on specific operations (SLT and SLTU).</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="ADD">6'b100000</parameter>
        <parameter id="ADDU">6'b100001</parameter>
        <parameter id="SUB">6'b100010</parameter>
        <parameter id="SUBU">6'b100011</parameter>
        <parameter id="AND">6'b100100</parameter>
        <parameter id="OR">6'b100101</parameter>
        <parameter id="XOR">6'b100110</parameter>
        <parameter id="NOR">6'b100111</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLT">6'b101010</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLTU">6'b101011</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLL">6'b000000</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRL">6'b000010</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRA">6'b000011</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLLV">6'b000100</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRLV">6'b000110</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRAV">6'b000111</parameter>
        <parameter id="LUI">6'b001111</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        <assign id="a_signed" width_description="[31:0]">Signed representation of input a.</assign>
        <assign id="b_signed" width_description="[31:0]">Signed representation of input b.</assign>
        <assign id="r" width_description="[31:0]">Result of the operation.</assign>
        <assign id="flag">Flag output, set based on specific operations (SLT and SLTU).</assign>
        <assign id="zero">Zero output, indicates if the result is zero.</assign>
        <assign id="carry">Carry output, indicates if a carry occurred during the operation.</assign>
        <assign id="negative">Negative output, indicates if the result is negative.</assign>
        <assign id="overflow">Overflow output, indicates if an overflow occurred during the operation.</assign>
        
        <always_comb>
            <case id="operation_selection">
                <item condition="aluc == ADD">Addition operation.</item>
                <item condition="aluc == ADDU">Unsigned Addition operation.</item>
                <item condition="aluc == SUB">Subtraction operation.</item>
                <item condition="aluc == SUBU">Unsigned Subtraction operation.</item>
                <item condition="aluc == AND">Bitwise AND operation.</item>
                <item condition="aluc == OR">Bitwise OR operation.</item>
                <item condition="aluc == XOR">Bitwise XOR operation.</item>
                <item condition="aluc == NOR">Bitwise NOR operation.</item>
                <item condition="aluc == SLT">Set Less Than operation.</item>
                <item condition="aluc == SLTU">Set Less Than Unsigned operation.</item>
                <item condition="aluc == SLL">Logical Shift Left operation.</item>
                <item condition="aluc == SRL">Logical Shift Right operation.</item>
                <item condition="aluc == SRA">Arithmetic Shift Right operation.</item>
                <item condition="aluc == SLLV">Variable Logical Shift Left operation.</item>
                <item condition="aluc == SRLV">Variable Logical Shift Right operation.</item>
                <item condition="aluc == SRAV">Variable Arithmetic Shift Right operation.</item>
                <item condition="aluc == LUI">Load Upper Immediate operation.</item>
                <default>Default case, sets result to high impedance.</default>
            </case>
            
            <if id="zero_flag">
                <condition expression="res == 32'h00000000">Result is zero.</condition>
                <then>zero <= 1'b1;</then>
                <else>zero <= 1'b0;</else>
            </if>
            
            <if id="flag_assignment">
                <condition expression="aluc == SLT || aluc == SLTU">Set flag based on specific operations.</condition>
                <then>flag <= res[0];</then>
                <else>flag <= 1'bz;</else>
            </if>
        </always_comb>
    </logic_description>
    
    <implementation>
        Assigns input operands to signed wires and outputs result to lower 32 bits of register.
        Sets flag output based on control signal (aluc) and is set to '1' when operation is SLT or SLTU, and 'z' otherwise.
        Sets zero output to '1' when result is all zeros, and '0' otherwise.
        Inside always block, case statement performs appropriate operation based on control signal (aluc).
        Result is assigned to register (res) accordingly.
        For shift operations (SLL, SRL, SRA, SLLV, SRLV, SRAV), shift amount is determined by value of 'a' or 'a[4:0]'.
        For LUI operation, upper 16 bits of 'a' are concatenated with 16 zeros to form result.
        If control signal (aluc) does not match any defined operation, result is assigned as 'z' (high impedance).
    </implementation>
</module>
